spectatorZones.name: Lusail Hill 普通观赛区

source.notes: Official event map linked from the organizer 2026 Grand Prix page. Hill viewing footprint manually traced separately from the surrounding blue Fan Zone and gold Hill Lounge. Piecewise-affine registration to 16 sourced turn coordinates, with affine continuation outside the hull. Schematic 3D artwork is not a survey; local placement may differ by tens of metres. Known road+0.75m and structure/pit+0.5m exclusions. 100m patches are computational partitions, not ticket sectors.

openingSource.notes: Organizer explicitly identifies General Admission Lusail Hill as the elevated Turn1 viewing area for 27–29 November2026. Ordinary public GA, not the separately sold Hill Lounge hospitality product.

surfaceSource.notes: Source GEDTM30 true-scale terrain with standing-eye1.65m and0.04m clearance. Approximate mapped Hill footprint;30m terrain does not resolve local terraces. Ground may occlude track, no eye/ground raised to force visibility.

geometryReview.method: User-approved approximate existing source map patches and source DEM, uncertainty retained in description/source. No sightline-driven changes.
